message.content:
**Uno – Quick Overview** | Item | Details | |------|---------| | **Deck** | 108 cards (4 colors × 25 cards + 8 special cards) | | **Goal** | Be the first player to score 500 points (or play all cards in a single round). | | **Setup** | • Deal 7 cards to each player.
• Place remaining cards face‑down as the draw pile.
• Turn top card face‑up to start the discard pile. | | **Turn Order** | Clockwise (unless reversed by a Reverse card). | | **Playing a Card** | • Match color, number, or symbol of top discard.
• If you have no playable card, draw one from the draw pile. | | **Special Cards** | • **Skip** – next player loses turn.
• **Reverse** – changes direction.
• **Draw Two** – next player draws two and skips turn.
• **Wild** – choose new color.
• **Wild Draw Four** – choose new color; next player draws four (must be played only if you have no matching color). | | **Calling “UNO”** | When you have one card left, shout “UNO!” before your opponent takes their turn. Failure to call results in drawing two penalty cards. | | **Winning a Round** | First player to discard all cards wins the round. | | **Scoring** | Winner scores sum of all cards left in opponents’ hands:
• Number cards = face value.
• Skip/Reverse/Draw Two = 20 points.
• Wild/Wild Draw Four = 50 points. | | **Game End** | First player to reach 500 points (or agreed target) wins the game. | **Key Strategy Tips** 1. Keep track of which colors have been played to anticipate opponents’ options. 2. Save Wild Draw Four for when you’re sure you have no matching color. 3. Use Reverse strategically to avoid being forced to draw when it’s your turn again. Enjoy playing Uno!
